rule: No suggestion is implemented until a reviewer records an Approved decision in this ledger. The static page displays decisions; it does not provide an approval control.

suggestions.title: Add play-by-play game logs
suggestions.proposal: Transcribe bounded game logs (e.g. one QB, 8-16 games) from official NFL boxscores to enable paired correlations and walk-forward demos.
suggestions.rationale: Season aggregates cannot support bet-leg dependence or temporal validation.
suggestions.missing_info: Official game-log URLs + bounded window + rights check.

suggestions.title: Transcribe full schedule (rest/travel)
suggestions.proposal: Transcribe Week 7-10 schedule rows to compute rest days, bye weeks and travel distance.
suggestions.rationale: NS03 cannot be tested without schedule features.

suggestions.title: Transcribe rosters / depth charts
suggestions.proposal: Transcribe bounded roster rows (e.g. NE, CHI, PIT, NO) to map 2nd/3rd/4th-string backups.
suggestions.rationale: Injury tracker cannot name replacements without depth data.
suggestions.missing_info: Bounded roster transcription + depth ordering definition.

suggestions.title: Add rushing/scoring team stats
suggestions.proposal: Transcribe team rushing and scoring tables to complete offense/defense picture.
suggestions.rationale: Passing-only snapshot omits half the game.

suggestions.title: Add weather data
suggestions.proposal: Add official game-site weather (temperature, wind, precipitation) as a total-points covariate.
suggestions.rationale: Weather affects passing efficiency and totals.

suggestions.title: Add licensed odds feed
suggestions.proposal: Obtain licensed pregame odds (open/close) to enable de-vigging and CLV.
suggestions.rationale: No market baseline exists without prices.
suggestions.missing_info: License + rights review (currently blocked by NFL Terms).

suggestions.title: Add snap counts / targets
suggestions.proposal: Add official snap/target data for prop modeling.

suggestions.title: Add betting-market settlement rules
suggestions.proposal: Document operator-specific settlement (voids, pushes, DNP, overtime) from official operator pages.

suggestions.title: Add preseason priors
suggestions.proposal: Add prior-season team/player aggregates as shrinkage priors.

suggestions.title: Add injury-history panel
suggestions.proposal: Transcribe multi-week injury reports to track availability trends.

suggestions.title: Improve site decision aids
suggestions.proposal: Add filterable deficiency matrix, abstention log and gate-evidence checklist to the dashboard.
suggestions.rationale: Decision-making needs explicit abstention and evidence tracking.
